portal.title: Exercise your data rights
portal.lede: Under India's DPDP Act 2023 you can ask any company to correct, complete or erase the personal data it holds about you. This portal is Kaveri Finserv's erasure desk. It works by voice or by text, and answers in the language you speak.
portal.rights.title: What happens to your request
portal.rights.p1: You describe, in one sentence, that you withdraw consent and want your data erased. The system reads your request, finds every copy of your data — in the data lake, the AI memory and the answer cache — and destroys it.
portal.rights.p2: When it is done you receive a signed certificate. You can check that certificate yourself, in your browser, without trusting us and without giving us your name again.
portal.rights.b1: Found and located: every copy of your data is searched across all systems.
portal.rights.b2: Checked by attack: after erasure, a red-team console tries to recover your data and must fail.
portal.rights.b3: Proof you can hold: a certificate with no personal data in it, anchored for independent verification.
portal.statute: The right is set out in the DPDP Act 2023, sections 12(1) and 6(6). Statutory mapping requires legal review.
portal.record.title: Speak your request
portal.record.hint: One sentence in your own words is enough.
portal.input.textPlaceholder: I withdraw my consent. Erase all my personal data. My phone number is …
portal.mic.deniedBody: The browser blocked the microphone, or none is connected. You can send the same request as text below — it carries the same legal weight.
portal.verify.title: One more step: it is really you
portal.verify.body: A 6-digit code was sent to your phone on record. In this demo the code is generated on the spot.
portal.tracker.title: Your request is moving
portal.tracker.received.h: We have your request and the recording.
portal.tracker.understood.h: Your words were read and the intent is confirmed.
portal.tracker.located.h: Every copy of your data was found across all systems.
portal.tracker.approved.h: A human officer signed off on the plan.
portal.tracker.erased.h: The data was destroyed, then attacked to prove it cannot come back.
portal.tracker.verified.h: A signed certificate was issued. Nothing was destroyed silently.
portal.receipt.title: Your erasure certificate
portal.receipt.held: What the law requires us to keep
portal.receipt.retentionIntro: If the law says Kaveri Finserv must keep a record (for example KYC papers under PMLA rules), it is written here with the release date when it will be erased without you asking again.
portal.receipt.nothingHeld: Nothing retained — everything the law permits was erased today.
portal.receipt.qr.hint: Point any phone camera here to reach the public verifier:
portal.receipt.secretIntro: One-time secret. This is the only time it is shown.
portal.receipt.secretWarning: Write it down or download your receipt — proving 'this certificate is mine' needs this secret. We show it once and keep only its hash.
portal.error.network: The service did not respond. Your request was not sent — try again in a moment.
portal.error.generic: Something broke on our side. The machine error code is kept in the page footer.
portal.poweredBy: ZeroTrace · erasure and proof infrastructure for Kaveri Finserv (demo)
portal.receipt.savedHash: Only a hash of that secret is retained: sha256(secret) equals the subject commitment.
